MvpPrompt.d1: 1. Define the MVP: the smallest version that proves the core value, and state explicitly what is left out for now.
MvpPrompt.d2: 2. Technical architecture: components, data flow, and an open-source stack; mark what can be sourced in Algeria and what must be imported.
MvpPrompt.d3: 3. A 12-week milestone plan, with a demo or measurable result at the end of each week.
MvpPrompt.d4: 4. Team: the roles required, how many people in each, and the skills to recruit at the university.
MvpPrompt.d5: 5. Budget in Algerian dinars (DZD): line items, costs and the main cost drivers.
MvpPrompt.d6: 6. Three validation experiments with success criteria and the number of users or samples required.
MvpPrompt.d7: 7. The five biggest technical, regulatory and market risks, each with a concrete mitigation.
MvpPrompt.d8: 8. The exact tasks for days 1 to 7, in order, with the expected outcome of each.
MvpPrompt.note: Assembled from this record — the assistant sees the same fields you see.
MvpPrompt.r1: Be concrete and numeric: dimensions, quantities, prices, deadlines.
MvpPrompt.r2: Prefer open-source tools, local suppliers and equipment available in Algerian universities.
MvpPrompt.r3: State assumptions explicitly instead of inventing facts; if the record is incomplete, say what is missing.
MvpPrompt.r4: Ask me up to five questions before starting, if the answers would change the plan.
MvpPrompt.role: You are a technical co-founder and R&D mentor advising a small university team in Algeria.
MvpPrompt.subtitle: Copy this into an AI assistant to get a complete plan for turning this project into an MVP.
MvpPrompt.task: Produce a practical plan to build a minimum viable product (MVP) for this project with a small student team in Algeria, within one semester and on a limited budget.
MvpPrompt.title: AI guidance prompt
